text: Remote Work Policy. Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with prior manager approval. Fully remote arrangements require written approval from the department head and HR. Remote employees must be reachable during core hours of 10:00 to 16:00 IST. Company equipment used at home remains subject to the IT Security Policy.

Annual Leave Policy. Full-time employees receive 24 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, accrued at 2 days per month. Up to 8 unused days may be carried over to the next calendar year. Carried-over days expire if not used by 31 March of the following year. Leave requests of more than 5 consecutive days must be submitted at least 2 weeks in advance.

Travel and Expense Policy. The daily meals allowance during business travel is capped at INR 1,500 per day. Itemised receipts are required for any single expense above INR 500. Economy class is mandatory for flights under 6 hours. Expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of the trip end date.

IT Security Policy. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is required for all VPN connections and for access to email from outside the office network. Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and rotated every 90 days. Lost or stolen devices must be reported to the IT helpdesk within 24 hours. Personal USB storage devices are not permitted on company laptops.

Parental Leave Policy. Birthing parents are entitled to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave. Non-birthing parents are entitled to 4 weeks of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 6 months of the child's birth or adoption. Adoptive parents receive the same entitlement as birthing parents for children under 3 months old.

Code of Conduct. Employees must not accept gifts from vendors valued above INR 2,000. Any conflict of interest must be disclosed to the Compliance team within 7 days of becoming aware of it. Harassment of any kind is prohibited and can be reported anonymously through the ethics hotline.

Data Retention Policy. Customer records must be retained for 7 years after the end of the customer relationship. Employee personnel files are retained for 5 years after separation. Data scheduled for deletion must be securely erased using IT-approved tools.

Overtime Policy. Overtime must be pre-approved by the line manager. Approved overtime is compensated at 1.5 times the regular hourly rate on weekdays and 2 times the regular hourly rate on public holidays. Employees may not work more than 10 hours of overtime per week.

Hardware Refresh Policy. Company laptops are eligible for replacement every 3 years. Employees may request an external monitor and keyboard for home use once per refresh cycle. Damaged equipment must be returned to IT before a replacement is issued.

Learning and Development Policy. Each employee has an annual learning budget of INR 40,000 for courses, certifications and conferences. Requests above INR 15,000 require manager approval before booking. Unused learning budget does not carry over to the next financial year.
